outcome: Type of anesthesia used for emergent cesarean sections
cohort: Women undergoing emergent cesarean sections at a tertiary care hospital
finding: The rate of spinal anesthesia for emergent cesarean sections increased significantly during the peak of the COVID-19 pandemic in tertiary care hospitals.
